Class AuthController

java.lang.Object
controller.AuthController
public class AuthController extends Object
Controller class responsible for handling authentication and user management operations Acts as an intermediary between the UI and the authentication repository

      public boolean createNewUser(String name, String email, String pwd, String roleId)
      Creates a new user in the system
      Parameters:
      name - The user's full name
      email - The user's email address (used as unique identifier)
      pwd - The user's password
      roleId - The role assigned to the user (PLAYER or EDITOR)

      true if user was successfully created, false if creation failed
